scope: CPU prompt optimization with the same synthetic rank-32/96-pair fixture; no quality claim
scratch_bytes_formula: 4 * 8 * (maximum attached rank + maximum attached output rows)

arithmetic.down: existing binary64 tensor product, row-partitioned through the CPU worker pool
arithmetic.up: independent binary64 sums per position and row; scale and base addition precede final F32 rounding
arithmetic.fallback: scalar for reference models, singleton products and non-little-endian hosts
arithmetic.publication: complete tiles after all matching attachments succeed and worker shares join

native_cli_memory_check.cache: f32, explicitly matched to the benchmark
native_cli_memory_check.weights: the file's own pages, read as they are touched
native_cli_memory_check.note: single RSS observation, not a cold-start timing comparison; earlier CLI memory check used default q4t

limitations: Before and after are separate shared-host batches; paired controls are within each batch
First tiled batch load 1.38..5.80, temperature 83.125..93.875 C; repeat load 4.82..6.32, 87.625..91.125 C
Five repeats per batch are descriptive; no significance or worst-case latency bound is claimed
Token arithmetic was not optimized and no decode speedup is claimed
No previous-executable no-adapter comparison or released 27B adapter evaluation was performed
Device execution, other arithmetic policies and long contexts remain unqualified by these measurements
